caption: The drawing shows a round, brown-toned object resembling a carved or pressed medallion or seal at the top center of the page. The medallion features a raised image of a chicken or rooster facing left, with a textured tail feather and a comb on its head, standing on two legs above two leafy plants. Above the chicken, there is an arched sprig of leaves. The border of the medallion is decorated with a repeated geometric pattern. Beneath the medallion, there is a thin black outline drawing of the object’s side profile, which shows a pedestal base and a vertical shaft supporting the round top. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is printed in uppercase letters above the outline drawing. The background of the page is a light cream color.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
